Election Information

The Gubernatorial Election will be held on November 3, 2026

  10/6/2026

 In-person Voter registration closes for deputy registrars and local election officials.
  10/18/2026

  Last day to register to vote by online application.

  10/19/2026  First day of early voting. Click HERE for locations (Wheeling's location is Chamber Park 131 N. Wolf Rd.)

  10/26/2026

  Last day to request a mail ballot, including military and overseas voters.

  11/2/2026

  Last day of early voting.

  11/3/2026

  Last day mail ballots can be postmarked.**

  11/3/2026

  Election Day (polls are open from 6:00 AM to 7:00 PM).

**IMPORTANT UPDATE REGARDING MAIL BALLOT POSTMARKS**

A new USPS postmark policy could impact whether ballots are counted if mailed close to Election Day. Voters should return mail ballots early or use an official ballot drop box. To locate an official Cook County Clerk’s Drop Box, go to www.cookcountyclerk.com/MBdropbox

Suburban Cook County residents can find key dates, deadlines, and other information about the 2026 Gubernatorial Elections by clicking on '2026 Elections' from the link below.
